en: The front side of this postcard displays a black-and-white photograph showing a wide, elegant boulevard lined with trees and ornate, multi-story buildings on both sides. Pedestrians are walking along the tree-lined promenade, and architectural details suggest a late 19th or early 20th-century European city. The lower portion of the image is covered by handwritten text in Swedish. The back side is divided for address and message, with clear Swedish text and postmarks, addressed to Göteborg (Gothenburg).
